description: Current two-digit identities, with one Shared vendor native part per repeated supplier-qualified SKU. Prior identity-migration-map.json remains immutable release provenance.

rules.allocation: Within each direct-parent namespace, assign NN from 50 upward in ascending previous vendor Number (MHA-VN-NN); for tool purchases, ascending prior TL-NN. Sequences reset per parent namespace.
rules.identity_segments: Shrink every numeric identity segment, including parent 005->05 and assembly 000->00. Do not treat configuration qualifier T006 as an identity sequence; retain it.
rules.cloning: One registry/native identity per repeated supplier-qualified SKU; SH means Shared. Distinct physical members use explicit named configurations. Unique supplier SKUs remain immediate-parent scoped.
rules.native_occurrence_reference: Role:ordinal; ordinal is 1-based and role-local, not a native Component2 instance index. Resolve rebuilt native Name2 only from checked file, configuration and ComponentReference readback.

classification_decisions.ch-pivot-bracket-tl-angle-plate: Shop-reworked bought stock remains fabricated tooling; only numeric width changes.
classification_decisions.pd-platen-rack: Fabricated from purchased rack stock; finished part remains fabricated.
